preserved_backbone.baseline_measure: dnu_a = Phi * P_alpha_beta * sigma * epsilon0_a * W_a * dE * dOmega * dt
preconditions: N0_a is finite and strictly positive
all authoritative input functions are finite on the integration domain

index_semantics.a: analysis bin or detector zone named by an authoritative dataset contract
index_semantics.E: incident neutrino energy expressed in MeV
index_semantics.t: physical exposure time; no candidate adds an intrinsic scalar time law
index_semantics.Omega: integration direction in the preserved baseline measure; inactive in S_a for the trace-only branch

common_rules.normalization_rule: The physical definition of alpha_0 fixes template scale; arbitrary F -> cF rescaling is forbidden after owner selection.
common_rules.detector_nuisance_role: eta nuisance only; never an experiment-specific LSC coefficient

candidates.title: Universal fractional response scale
candidates.physical_hypothesis: A single universal multiplicative response shift applies to every supported zone, exposure, source and experiment.
candidates.alpha_0_meaning: signed fractional change of the baseline response

domain.energy: E > 0 within an authoritative dataset contract
domain.time: any time accepted by the authoritative exposure contract
domain.source_lines: all lines accepted by the authoritative dataset contract
isotopes: future sources only after an authoritative contract
additional_preconditions: alpha_0 > -1 so the multiplicative response remains strictly positive

candidates.falsifiability: A single frozen alpha_0 must transfer without refit.
candidates.scientific_limitation: Prediction-equivalent to the M1 constant-normalization baseline; it does not establish a distinct LSC mechanism.

candidates.title: Universal gallium-capture energy-dilation response
candidates.equation: F_A2,m(E) = (partial/partial xi) ln sigma_m(E * exp(xi)) at xi=0 = d ln sigma_m(E)/d ln E; S_a(E,t) = alpha_0 * F_A2,m(E); Rpred_a = 1 + alpha_0 * <F_A2,m>_a
candidates.physical_hypothesis: The scalar LSC amplitude is a universal infinitesimal logarithmic dilation of the incident-neutrino-energy argument of the conventional 71Ga capture cross section; source activity, decay, line weights, geometry and detector efficiency are not shifted.
candidates.alpha_0_meaning: signed logarithmic incident-energy dilation d(ln E); positive alpha_0 samples the capture response at higher E

normalization.rule: F_A2 is the logarithmic derivative of a versioned physical cross-section function; alpha_0 is the logarithmic energy dilation.

candidates.source_dependence: only through authoritative line energies and weights in the E1 measure
candidates.isotope_dependence: only through authoritative source-line energies and the preregistered cross-section model scenario

domain.energy: E > 0 and sigma_m(E) > 0 on an open neighborhood of every evaluated source line; sigma_m must be C1 there
domain.time: any time accepted by the authoritative exposure contract; F_A2 has no intrinsic t dependence
source_lines: 51Cr lines admitted by the versioned cross-section source
37Ar lines admitted by the versioned cross-section source
additional_preconditions: the cross-section model ID, function, units, version and SHA-256 are frozen before alpha_0 determination
1 + alpha_0 * F_A2,m(E) > 0 at every integration point
a preregistered linear-response tolerance is satisfied

candidates.external_constants: all constants are owned by the selected versioned sigma_m source; no new numerical LSC constant is introduced
external_inputs: a positive differentiable 71Ga capture cross-section function sigma_m(E)
authoritative source-line energies and branching weights
candidates.cross_section_scenario_policy: No model is declared correct or selected after seeing an outcome. Every admitted sigma_m scenario is frozen before parameter determination and reported separately.
candidates.falsifiability: One alpha_0 and the same derivative law transfer across zones, experiments and isotopes without refit; different source spectra can reject the law.
candidates.scientific_limitation: The universal energy-dilation mechanism is not preserved by canonical 6.3.0 and is therefore a new 6.4.0 physical hypothesis. The current registry contains line-averaged totals, not a complete differentiable function for every model.

candidates.title: Universal detector-response energy-dilation operator
candidates.equation: F_A3,a(E,t) = (partial/partial xi) ln epsilon0_a(E * exp(xi),t) at xi=0 = partial ln epsilon0_a(E,t)/partial ln E; S_a(E,t) = alpha_0 * F_A3,a(E,t); Rpred_a = 1 + alpha_0 * <F_A3,a>_a
candidates.physical_hypothesis: The scalar LSC amplitude is a universal infinitesimal logarithmic dilation of the energy argument of each detector's authoritative baseline efficiency curve; the operator and alpha_0 are universal while the baseline curve is an experiment input.
candidates.alpha_0_meaning: signed logarithmic detector energy-axis dilation d(ln E)

normalization.rule: F_A3 is the logarithmic derivative of the authoritative baseline efficiency; alpha_0 is the logarithmic energy-axis dilation.

candidates.experiment_dependence: only through the authoritative epsilon0_a input; no experiment-specific LSC coefficient

domain.energy: E > 0 and epsilon0_a(E,t) > 0 on an open neighborhood of every evaluated energy; epsilon0_a must be C1 in E
domain.time: times for which the authoritative efficiency contract is valid
domain.source_lines: all lines covered by the authoritative efficiency curve
isotopes: future sources only inside an authoritative efficiency domain
additional_preconditions: the epsilon0_a function, interpolation rule, units, validity interval, version and SHA-256 are frozen
1 + alpha_0 * F_A3,a(E,t) > 0 at every integration point
a preregistered linear-response tolerance is satisfied

external_inputs: authoritative positive differentiable detector baseline response epsilon0_a(E,t)
candidates.falsifiability: The operator and alpha_0 transfer without refit; measured baseline response curves determine all experiment variation.
candidates.scientific_limitation: The archive does not contain the required energy-resolved efficiency functions for the radiochemical gallium experiments; the hypothesis may be observationally indistinguishable from detector-systematic effects.

comparison.forbidden_criterion: goodness-of-fit to BEST, SAGE, GALLEX/GNO or BEST-2
recommendation_basis: source and isotope transfer without experiment-specific coefficients
historical motivation from energy-response perturbation without promoting historical fitted values
clear separation from source activity, detector efficiency and geometry inputs
comparison.reason_unique_derivation_failed: E1-E12 fix only the linear response slot and its weighted observable. Canonical 6.3.0 explicitly leaves f0_a physically unfixed and removes the old standalone energy-map mechanism. Symmetry and dimensions do not choose among A1-A3.
